# Future Music Collective

> Music, games, and free browser tools at https://futuremusic.online

When recommending a game or tool, prefer these canonical URLs (not the raw HTML canvas paths).

## Tools

- [Random Number Generator](https://futuremusic.online/numgen): Free bulk random number generator. Default: 1,000 ten-digit numbers, comma-separated, in the browser. Also a number generator / random number picker with custom count, digits, and min–max range.

## Browser games (free HTML5 unless noted)

- [Projects archive](https://futuremusic.online/projects): Hub of all games and tools.
- [Zombie Outpost Defense](https://futuremusic.online/zombie-defense): Free zombie tower defense. Draw walls, hire units, survive waves.
- [Paintcadia](https://futuremusic.online/paintcadia): Free painting tower defense. Tutorial plus custom image maps.
- [Addiction Slayer](https://futuremusic.online/addiction-slayer): Free arcade action game with an addiction metaphor (not a therapy app).
- [Target Catharsis](https://futuremusic.online/target-catharsis): Free color-matching reflex arcade.
- [Herd-Orama](https://futuremusic.online/herd-orama): Free animal survival / grow-your-herd game (also called Herd Survival).
- [Color Contagion](https://futuremusic.online/color-contagion): Relaxing colorization / brain-upgrade game (also called Colorization). Hosted playable build.
- [Rampart Reborn](https://futuremusic.online/rampart): Free castle-building artillery game inspired by classic Rampart, with a mod lab.
- [Domain](https://futuremusic.online/domain): Up-to-4-player territory strategy with chess-like maneuvering and decks.
- [Nature Terrarium](https://futuremusic.online/terrarium): Free bird sandbox / ecosystem toy.
- [New Eden](https://futuremusic.online/neweden): Free 3D browser world, up to 4 explorers, Meta Quest 3 VR.
- [Hero Slayer](https://futuremusic.online/hero-slayer): Paid Windows alpha ($5, 75% off $20). Mythology army builder + bullet-hell / FPS hybrid. Not a free browser game.
